But off-grid true tail 3.5–4 m/s launches and then fails KE (21–22 J) and headClear (0.36 m); the 39-case grid hides the gap; the t=0 estimate has no 10 s history (false refusals in crossL9/crossR9 s13)

physics.killTest: sweep tail 3–6 m/s in 0.25 m/s steps × seeds; field-test belt anemometer bias

findings.title: Unsafe tailwind gap between the ensemble grid points (3.5–4 m/s): KE 21–22 J, head clearance 0.36 m
findings.detail: Off-grid runs (same seeds): tail3.5_s11 KE 21.8 J, ops 3; tail4_s11 KE 21.3 J, headClear 0.93 m, ops 3; tail4_s12 headClear 0.36 m (deep-stall drop overtaken by the tailwind at the rest stop). Causes: the 4.5 m/s gate on a ±1 m/s biased estimate lets 3.5–4.5 m/s tailwinds launch, and a refused relaunch snow-pulls the parked glider into the holster at ≈18 m/s ground speed. The 39-case pass on keMax/headClear is a grid artefact.

findings.title: headClear passes by 1 cm only on the concept's own head model; <1.0 m in 9/39 runs with the brief's helmet approximation
findings.detail: Minimum 1.011 m (crossL9_s12, deep-stall drop at the rest stop while the rider decelerates). Same geometry to an upright helmet at pos + 1.61 m: 0.859 m. Dev scenarios also show 0.79 m (beginner 6 m/s), 0.55 m (moguls), 0.92 m (dock variant).

findings.title: avail fails (72.0 %) for a structural reason: the tailwind gate refuses 6/39 runs and its t=0 estimate also refuses whole rides in 9 m/s crosswind
findings.detail: Launched runs 85.1 % (passes); tail 28 %, cross 82 %, head 90 %. crossL9_s13/crossR9_s13 lose the first ride because windEstimate at t=0.5 s has no history (single sample + bias = 4.8 m/s down-slope in a pure crosswind).

findings.title: Jitter pass rests on an 8 % EIS residual and 0.15° mount deadband (both ASSUMED)
findings.detail: p90 1.92 reproduced; 15 % residual → 2.99 (edge), 25 % → 4.65, 0.5° deadband → 3.51 °/s (fail). Verdict conditional until measured.

findings.title: Endurance omits lift-time idle power (39 min if the hip unit stays on)
findings.detail: 0.66 W (reel idle 0.3 + hip electronics 0.3 + stowed glider) × 8 min lift per run is not charged; needs a modelled sleep mode with GNSS geofence wake.

findings.title: Leash lies on the snow / ≤0.45 m high 1–2 m behind the rider
findings.detail: Own line-height recompute incl. sled tow: min 0.004 m, p10 ≈0.25–0.43 m. Low trip-line rather than clothesline; dev crossing strike force ≤1.9 N with pull-through. Documented, not judged.

findings.title: Narrow rider envelope
findings.detail: avail ≥80 % only at 8–13 m/s and ≤≈20°; ≥15 m/s or 24° the glider is released and the walk-up costs 400–1300 s; beginners/moguls fail headClear.

safetyRegulatory: Resort written permission (tethered flying object on piste) — not obtained.
Leash on/near the snow behind the rider during launch and sled tow: trip hazard for following skiers.
Glider (132 g) at ≤14 J in the 39-case grid but 21–22 J and 0.36 m from the head in 3.5–4 m/s tailwind (off-grid).
Sub-250 g tethered glider: tethered-aircraft rules vary; EU C0 class weight but follow-me/tether rules unclear.
credibleEnvelope: Simulation-credible only for intermediate carving riders at 8–13 m/s on ≤≈20° groomed, low-traffic pistes, calm/head/cross wind ≤9 m/s and tailwind ≤3 m/s, AND an EIS/mount that keeps ≤≈12 % residual, a holster that captures a snow-pulled folded glider, and a leash surviving reel flexing. Tailwind 3.5–4.5 m/s is unsafe as modelled; ≥4.5 m/s no flight.
verdict: Reproduces exactly (39/39). Fails the judged avail (72.0 %; launched runs 85.1 %). Passes the other 12 on the grid, but jitter, keMax, endurance and headClear are conditional: the 1 cm head clearance and 0.9 J KE margin hold only at the grid winds — an off-grid 3.5–4 m/s tailwind gives 21–22 J and a 0.36 m head pass — and jitter rests on an assumed 8 % EIS residual. Lowest user burden of the field (ops 1, setup 12 s, 0.46 kg worn, 2.8 L), but not a usable product until the tailwind band and stop/drop behaviour are made safe.
